constraints: 2<=N<=100;elements<=10000;B2 iff positive strictly increasing and all i<=j sums distinct;EOF;blank line aftercase.
independentMethod: Enumerate pair sums into a list, sort and compare adjacent values; positivity/order checked independently; includes diagonal pairs.

mutations.label: Sorts an invalid original order
mutations.replace: for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) for (int j = i; j > 0 && a[j] < a[j-1]; --j) { auto temp = a[j]; a[j] = a[j-1]; a[j-1] = temp; } bool good = true;
